entry.name: live.path
entry.digest: Navigate to objects in the Live application
entry.description: live.path is used to navigate to Live objects on which the live.object, live.observer and live.remote~ objects operate. The navigation is purely path-based and is independent of the objects currently present in Live (navigating to a nonexistent path will result in the message id 0 being sent out the left and middle outputs rather than an error message). Note: The Live API runs in the main thread in Live, and all messages to and from the API are automatically deferred.

arguments.name: initial path
arguments.description: Specify an initial path as argument to, without any quotes.
